median_method: Interval bounds: each non-detect bounded between 0 and its own reporting limit; median computed at both bounds. Early median bounds 1.9-2.0 (not unique, so reported as null with bounds in notes); late 3.3 at both bounds (identified). Half-limit substitution used only as a labelled sensitivity check (same values).
notes: Filter: USGSPCode 01000, dissolved, ug/L, ActivityType Sample-Routine, subdivision Groundwater (3559 -> 2997 rows; replicates, reference material, 'Not determined', and non-groundwater subdivisions dropped). 3 'Detected Not Quantified' rows (early, no value, limits 1.8-1.9) are excluded from medians/shares (counted in n). Early median bounds [1.9, 2.0]; late [3.3, 3.3]. Share>10 bounds early [0.1564927857935627, 0.1564927857935627], late [0.30788590604026844, 0.31208053691275167] (late ND limits up to 20 ug/L make a few NDs ambiguous; early max limit 5 <10 so exactly identified). Shares are of 1802 early / 1192 late rows with value or ND. Limits changed from mostly 1-2 ug/L (early, up to 5) to ~0.1 ug/L (late), but ND share is only 11% vs 4%, and the medians lie above nearly all limits, so censoring barely affects them. Pooled wells differ (659 early vs 629 late; 295 in both). In the 295 shared wells (267 with differing per-well medians) the late per-well median is lower in 170, higher in 97, tied 28 (sign test p=9.3e-06); shared-well pooled share>10 rises 0.18->0.29 while per-well medians fall, so evidence is mixed. Repeated samples within wells are not independent; no CI given for pooled values.
